title: Public product discovery
expected: Only approved projections, costs, drawdown and performance origin are visible.

title: Portfolio detail and track record
expected: Correct version/history, disclosure, risk and compatibility; no restricted source raw text.

title: Signup and email verification
expected: Tenant-bound identity, no paid or trading privilege before independent gates.

title: Residence and service eligibility
expected: Exact legal/product/channel approval, no inferred or user-editable bypass.

title: Hosted checkout
expected: Whitelisted price and customer identity; success page never creates entitlement.

title: Upgrade/downgrade/cancel
expected: Correct interval/fees, safe open-episode treatment and separate platform state.

title: Select licensed portfolio
expected: Effective version, risk/capacity/rights and customer scope preserved.

title: Alert stream and history
expected: Correct lifecycle sequence, expiry, origin and delivered-versus-filled distinction.

title: Email/API delivery preferences
expected: Verified endpoint and lawful consent; safety policy distinguished from marketing.

title: Hosted platform connection
expected: Correct account/environment and token scope; no browser or other-tenant key leakage.

title: Copy mandate and activation
expected: Explicit new-only/sync choice, exact constraints, independent billing and mandate.

title: Customer performance
expected: Only customer actual observations, real fees/marks and incomplete flags.

title: Trade and order-family detail
expected: Actual quantities, uncertainty, children, corrections and stop coverage reconcile.

title: Pause, stop copying and handoff
expected: Scope-specific approved wind-down; no whole-account surprise flatten.

title: Support and incident reporting
expected: Narrow staff rights, audit trail and safe communications.

title: Research source universe
expected: Licensed complete history, known-flat versus missing, exact source versions.

title: Candidate research job
expected: All fixed subsets/recipes terminal outcomes, resumable deterministic shards.

title: Compare portfolio candidates
expected: Holdout separation, fees/capacity/correlations and rejected candidates visible.

title: Release approval
expected: Separate reviewer, immutable artifact/version/rights and audience scope.

title: Publisher control and reconciliation
expected: Exact external strategy, unknown operations, quota and writer state.

title: Rights and legal review administration
expected: Evidence-only permissions, restricted changes and expiry/wind-down preview.

title: Business economics and royalty reports
expected: Subscription revenue/costs separate from trading P&L.

title: PAMM/MAM onboarding/report
expected: Broker-native status, mandates, units/NAV/fees, no SaaS custody.

title: Standby/restore/incident operation
expected: No financial authority before fence, current grants and external reconciliation.
